fields.name: Switches
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1E50410 fills +0x10..+0x73 with 0xFF (25 null FixedStrings); live values are FixedString indices or 0xFFFFFFFF. Written by the GameplayActivationLegacyHelper::Refresh* functions (StepSpeed, CharacterWeight, FootstepsType, BodyType, Race, Equipment, SpellCastSwitches, GroundMaterial, SpeakerID) - one switch value each. Slot hints from the macOS build only (offsets there are not proof): +0x10 SpeakerID (RefreshSpeakerID writes the FixedString at +0x10 and posts it as switch group SpeakerID), +0x18 Race, +0x1C BodyType, +0x24 StepSpeed (Steps_Walk/...), +0x28 CharacterWeight; the Windows Refresh* functions are virtual methods of the helper object at GameplayActivationSystem+0x10 (calls through slots 0x70..0x98 in bg3.exe+0x1E43860) and were not located.
